Speaker: Dr. Sera Gunn

Abstract: We will look at the various ways that the mathematics of curves and
surfaces is analogous to that of polygons and graphs (networks of vertices and
edges). This analogy is more than coincidental and we will see not only that
the same properties that hold for the continuous world also hold for the
discrete world but how to use each world to obtain results in the other.

**Pizza and snacks will be provided!**
